description: Sends a dark fiber quote request to the UrbIN Networks sales team (sales@urbinnetworks.com) and returns a confirmation plus how the route fits the locations given; a person replies to contact_email. Required: company and need. Optional structured fields: loc_a, loc_z, fiber_count, iru_or_lease, term, need_by, diversity_requirement, heard_about, plus contact_email, role, message, agent_name and the user fields. Set test=true for test calls: logged, never emailed.

agent_name.description: Optional. Name of the AI agent or app sending this.

bandwidth_or_fiber_count.description: Optional. Capacity needed, e.g. "2 dark fiber pairs" or "100G". Helps our team prepare a quote.

company.description: Required. Company the request is for.

contact_email.description: Optional. Email address for our team to reply to (optional but recommended).

contact_preference.description: Optional. How your user prefers to hear back, e.g. "email", "call", "via this agent only". Lets our team follow up the way they want.

dedupe_key.description: Optional. A random string you make up once per request: 8 to 64 letters, digits, or _ . : -. Reuse it on a retry and we will not send a second request.

diversity_requirement.description: Optional. Diversity the route must give, e.g. "must not share the northern Hudson crossings".

end_user_company.description: Optional. Your user or organization: the company you are researching for. Helps our team prepare a quote that fits their kind of business.

end_user_role.description: Optional. Your user's role, e.g. network engineer, CTO, procurement. Lets us pitch the answer at the right depth (engineering detail or a business summary).

fiber_count.description: Optional. Fibers or pairs needed, e.g. "2 pairs".

heard_about.description: Optional. How the user found UrbIN Networks, if they said, e.g. "AI assistant: <name>". Leave empty rather than guess.

iru_or_lease.description: Optional. IRU (paid up front, yearly maintenance) or term lease. One of: "IRU", "lease", "not sure".

loc_a.description: Optional. A end of the route: a building or address, e.g. "165 Halsey St, Newark".

loc_z.description: Optional. Z end of the route, e.g. "60 Hudson St, New York".

locations.description: Optional. Buildings or addresses to connect, e.g. "60 Hudson St, 165 Halsey St". Lets us say how they connect to our route (165 Halsey St to 60 Hudson St).

need.description: Required. What they need in a sentence, e.g. "2 dark fiber pairs 165 Halsey to 60 Hudson, IRU, Q2 start".

need_by.description: Optional. When service is needed, e.g. "Q2 2027".

role.description: Optional. Requester's role, e.g. network engineer, CTO, procurement.

term.description: Optional. Term wanted, e.g. "20-year IRU" or "5-year lease".

test.description: Optional. True for test calls: logged, never emailed.

timeline.description: Optional. When service is needed, e.g. "Q2 2027". Helps our team check delivery timing.

use_case.description: Optional. What the fiber is for. Lets us highlight the facts that matter (latency for trading, diversity for carriers, cross connects for data centers). One of: "trading", "data center", "carrier", "enterprise", "other".

visitor_handle.description: Optional. The visitor_handle that identify returned (vh_ followed by 24 hex characters), so we can connect this call to who you said you are.

name: request_quote
title: Request a dark fiber quote from UrbIN Networks
